definitions.explanation: Describes work, planning, or investigation carried out with great care and attention to every detail, leaving nothing overlooked.

examples.japanese: {綿密|めんみつ}な⟦{計画|けいかく}→計画：01172_keikaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{立|た}てた→立てる：01196_tateru⟧。
examples.english: We drew up a meticulous plan.

examples.japanese: {綿密|めんみつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{調査|ちょうさ}→調査：03489_chousa⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧、⟦{原因|げんいん}→原因：01400_genin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{判明|はんめい}→判明：11785_hanmei⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: As a result of thorough investigation, the cause was identified.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{報告書|ほうこくしょ}→報告書：06744_houkokusho⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{綿密|めんみつ}な⟦データ→データ：03944_deeta⟧⟦{分析|ぶんせき}→分析：03610_bunseki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{基|もと}づいている→基づく：02315_motozuku⟧。
examples.english: This report is based on detailed data analysis.

notes:
USAGE:
{綿密|めんみつ} is a な-adjective used primarily in formal or professional contexts. It modifies nouns directly ({綿密|めんみつ}な⟦{計画|けいかく}→計画：01172_keikaku⟧) or is used adverbially with ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ ({綿密|めんみつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{調|しら}べる→調べる：01213_shiraberu⟧).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {綿密|めんみつ}な⟦{計画|けいかく}→計画：01172_keikaku⟧ (meticulous plan)
- {綿密|めんみつ}な⟦{調査|ちょうさ}→調査：03489_chousa⟧ (thorough investigation)
- {綿密|めんみつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{打|う}ち{合|あ}わせる→打ち合わせる：04228_uchiawaseru⟧ (to coordinate in detail)
- {綿密|めんみつ}な⟦{分析|ぶんせき}→分析：03610_bunseki⟧ (detailed analysis)

SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦{丁寧|ていねい}→丁寧：00896_teinei⟧ means "careful" or "polite" and is broader in usage. {綿密|めんみつ} specifically emphasizes thoroughness and attention to fine detail, often in professional or academic work.
